items.title: Can AI stop exam paper leaks in India? Inside the Bharat EduAI Stack
items.summary: India's education system is on the verge of a massive technological shift. With the launch of the Bharat EduAI Stack and the new Bodhan AI Centre of Excellence at IIT Madras, artificial intelligence is stepping out of the lab and into government schools. But how exactly will this Digital Public Infrastructure work on the ground? In this episode of Front Page, we sit down with Anoop from Bodhan AI. After spending over eight years at Microsoft, Anoop is now building sovereign, open-weight foundational models for Indian languages—Indic-Transcribe, Indic-Speak, Indic-OCR, and Indic-Translate—specifically designed to bridge the linguistic and socioeconomic gaps in India. In this episode, we cover: The Bharat EduAI Stack: What this new digital framework actually is, who will govern it, and how government schools can deploy it without massive hardware budgets. Solving the Exam Leak Crisis: We break down Nandan Nilekani's bold proposal to use AI to generate NTA exam question papers on the day of the test to prevent leaks. AI Tutors vs Teachers: How AI will act as a co-pilot for teachers rather than a replacement, and how AI tutors for Classes 6–12 will adapt to different state curriculums. The Sovereign AI Reality: Does India actually have the high-quality language data, compute, and research talent needed to build frontier models, or are we still behind the West? Open Models & Commercial Adoption: How Bodhan AI plans to balance open-weight releases with hosted APIs for edtech startups. Do you think AI-generated question papers are the ultimate solution to India's exam leak crisis, or do they introduce a new set of risks? items.title: ChatGPT Wallet Hides Your Card Behind A Token And Needs Face ID To Pay #Shorts #FrontPage
items.summary: With ChatGPT Wallet you review the seller, what you are buying, the total and the card, then approve with Face ID or a fingerprint. The payment network issues a token for checkout, so your real card details stay hidden from the agent and the seller. Approval and a completed order are separate steps. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #OpenAI #AgenticAI
